summary: Retest of the iteration-21 fixes. All 8 listed fixes are verified. Backend full suite: 155/155 passed, and the earlier xfail now passes. A new file, test_iter23_retest_fixes.py, has 4 tests and all pass. UI checks (Playwright, fresh visitors, 12-branch example): (1) Quote condition decisions now add up instead of overwriting each other. Clicking quote-condition-0-in_offer then quote-condition-1-resolved keeps both selected. The blocker went from '(2 open)' to '(1 open)' and then away. Changing c0 to resolved keeps c1. Decisions survive a re-save and reopening the panel. The quote-condition-decisions testid is present and quote-conditions is now used only once. (2) The quote-partial-ack checkbox ticks, unticks and ticks again, and its state matches the server: the 'Open scopes (S03)' blocker appears and disappears with it. It also stays checked after the panel is reopened. (3) A 30-page / 59k-char PDF read in batches: every fact from pages 21-30 cites its real page (21..30), and pages 1-11 are also correct. (4) Alder with valid C-10 plus a C-39 requirement is 'evidence_needed'. Wrong class (Redwood C-33) and expired evidence (Birch) are still 'does_not_fit'. (5) The PUT quote preview now includes the job exclusion 'Ceiling repairs' and not_covered S03, matching GET preview. partial_ack true/false switches the blocker. (6) On redraft, the Draft plan sheet preselects all 5 firms (aria-pressed=true), including Cedar and Dogwood, which were not in v1. (7) An organizer-added C-39 'Required' row shows Dismiss (and no Confirm). A 3-char reason keeps the Save button disabled. 'Added by mistake' dismisses it and shows 'dismissed: Added by mistake'. (8) The advance reply now says 'It won't select a plan, create review links...', S03 stays open, the plan is unselected and 0 links are created.

minor.issue: For batch 2+ facts the returned 'offset' is relative to the batch chunk, not the full source text (the page and line are correct). This only matters if a client ever uses offset for highlighting in the full text.

issues: The dismiss-reason form has no Cancel. After clicking Dismiss, the user can only leave by closing the sheet.
evidence-expires and quote-valid-until still use native date pickers, and evidence-firm is a native select (not shadcn). Carried over from earlier iterations.

Optional: make locate() offsets relative to the full source text for later batches (or document that they are batch-relative)

The quote blockers list only shows once every required field is filled (tax_basis, payment_terms included). To create open scopes, POST /api/project/draft with keep_open:["S03"]. Run single tests with '-n 0' (pytest.ini sets xdist). Upload kinds: brief, quote, email, other.
rca of the issue: No new bugs. All iteration-21 RCAs are fixed: Draft decisions are now built from preview.readiness.conditions, ack has local state, and locate() uses the nearest [Page N] marker.
